question: Which state government has initiated transformative industrial reform campaign called Udyog Kranti in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Government of Punjab** officially launched the **Udyog Kranti** campaign in **June 2025** as a landmark initiative to overhaul the state's industrial ecosystem.
 
• The campaign aims to position **Punjab** as a **global investment destination** by implementing transformative **industrial reforms** that prioritize efficiency and transparency.
 
• A primary focus of **Udyog Kranti** is the enhancement of the **Ease of Doing Business (EoDB)** framework, significantly reducing the **regulatory compliance burden** for both new and existing industries.
 
• It introduces an upgraded **Single Window Clearance System**, which mandates the **time-bound delivery** of all necessary permits, licenses, and **No Objection Certificates (NOCs)** through a digital interface.
 
• The initiative specifically targets the growth of Micro, Small, and Medium
